title: Nutritious Crispy Filipino Mung Bean Sprouts Fried Rice
description: A rich and crispy Filipino dish featuring mung bean sprouts, this recipe is a show-off dish that is satvik-friendly and has an al-dente finish. It is a perfect meal for anyone looking for a nutritious and flavorful dish.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the mung bean sprouts and cook until they start to soften.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet or wok and stir-fry for 5 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, salt, and pepper to the rice mixture and stir-fry for another 2 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the fried rice to a serving platter and serve hot.
